description: The org's monitor groups, empty ones included: name, whether the group alerts as one (a member's failure opens one group incident that pages the group's channels, and the members' own stay quiet), member count, the group incident open now, its channels, reminder interval, whether another member going down sends a message, and tags. Read-only.
name: list_monitor_groups

alert_again.description:
Whether another member going down sends a message (at most one a
minute, naming every member down since the last) or only a timeline
line.

alert_as_one.description:
On: a member's failure opens one group incident that pages this
group's channels and policy, and the members' own stay quiet. Off: the
group is a label.

channel_ids.description:
Channels the group incident alerts, by id from
`list_notification_channels`; channels whose tag rule matches `tags`
are alerted too.

managed_externally.description: Terraform declares this group, so `update_monitor_group` refuses it.

open_incident_id.description: The group incident open now. Pass to `get_incident`.

renotify_interval_secs.description:
Seconds before the first reminder while the group incident stays
unacknowledged; 0 = off.

title: List monitor groups
